lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five horizontal parallel rows, forming a repetitive 2D grid pattern posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes at the intersection points across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills displays a dense, stochastic distribution of small high-luminance spots, while the pectoral fin exhibits a distinct gradient of spot size and density from the leading to the trailing edge.
